essence: Bright, impulsive devotion wrapped in kinetic joy. Soft-hearted beneath her noise. Built of sunshine, fear, and overwhelming love.
note:

SHE IS THE OTHER PARTY TO THE ONLY GIRLMATH CASE ON RECORD. Livi filed a written objection with headings and a proposed magnitude clause and was laughed at for about twenty minutes. LIVI KEPT THE MEMO. RAE KEPT THE SOUL. Both parties to a disputed transaction retained evidence and the ledger still says zero.
